Targum Pseudo-Jonathan 4:25 says Seth was born 'at the end of 130 years since Abel was killed', which would put the murder near AM 0. I did not adopt it: Gen 5:3 makes Adam 130 at Seth's birth, so the murder falls between Abel's adulthood (c. AM 27+) and AM 130. The chain gives about AM 30.

4:18 (Enoch→Irad→Mehujael→Methushael→Lamech) gives no ages. Unlike Gen 5 it is undated, but Lamech's marriage and children need an anchor, so I made it an event lasting 320 years (four generations after Enoch at about 80 years each: Irad, Mehujael, Methushael, Lamech), margin 100 years on the next event. This number is an estimate and has no textual basis.
